parsed.notes: The Credit Facility leverage ratio is stated as a percentage limit (not in excess of 60%). It appears to be a debt-to-capitalization measure rather than debt/EBITDA, so it is classified as 'other'. The Interest Coverage Ratio is an either/or test: the company must meet the 1.5x minimum or hold a minimum amount of available liquidity. Dollar covenants are omitted because they are not ratios: Consolidated Tangible Net Worth (≥$2,263.3M vs. actual $3,136.8M) and Investments in Unrestricted Subsidiaries and Joint Ventures (≤$941.1M vs. actual $10.0M). Also omitted are the M/I Financial mortgage repurchase facility covenants (Leverage Ratio ≤12.0x vs. 7.08x actual; liquidity, adjusted net income and tangible net worth tests), because these are warehouse repurchase facilities rather than bank revolving credit or term loan agreements.
